source.branchContext: Current main baseline plus the scoped transport/startup repairs in codex/ghostpay-browser-isolation-20261118; active privacy integrations remain separate.

scope: Application-controlled browser networking for full and lean Pages builds; backend/node-only/unshipped research transports are not represented as shipped behavior.
evidenceKind: Source-reviewed inventory. Regression and browser evidence is recorded separately in docs/handoffs/BROWSER_NETWORK_ISOLATION_2026-11-18.md; catalog coverage is not a guarantee of universal enforcement.
applicationEnforceable: Reject redirects and unapproved endpoint switching
Omit application cookies/referrer and prevent response caching where APIs permit
Apply selected policy at each app-controlled dispatch and retry
Minimize payloads and avoid keys/secret identifiers in network data
Keep network-free workers behind constrained main-thread bridges
Use same-origin active assets and detect new egress in tests
unavoidableOrExternal: Browser-selected DNS, source IP, TLS/SNI, timing, HTTP Origin/CORS, browser/extension traffic and endpoint logging cannot be fully hidden or governed by a static application.
Public-chain payer, amount, asset, timing and transaction relationships remain visible.
A selected RPC, relayer, oracle or merchant can observe requests it receives.
Host compromise can change JavaScript; an in-app hash is not independent source attestation.
Already-dispatched requests and broadcasts cannot be made unsent by a later policy change or page reload.
activeWorkBoundary: Recovery/keypair export, Mythril remediation, broad consolidation, #222 privacy integration, #228 own-node guard, #231 sweep consent and #233 existing journey fixtures remain separate owners. This task repairs unowned lower transport/startup files.

surfaces.failureBehavior: Ordinary browser load failures; no fallback CDN or mandatory third-party assets were found.
surfaces.ownership: Source review only; hosting/CSP changes may overlap active Pages work.

surfaces.failureBehavior: Fixed hash-unavailable UI; no retry/fallback; 8 MiB streamed cap and 15-second deadline cover non-cooperative injected fetch/streams; late bodies discarded.

policyScopeStatement: The current branch does not implement universal private-path enforcement. Settings persistence, cross-tab changes, consent, cached clients, other-chain routing and active integration PRs remain explicit dependencies.

nonShippedAdapters.change: Honor Request method and cancellation before dispatch; cancellation after dispatch cannot retract bytes.
